verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says its AI Agents answer calls automatically after hours, during peak volume and for repetitive requests, which covers the 'answer the line' part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents the AI agent taking a message or handing a live call to a human. The shared-inbox 'step in' claim is about team collaboration in general, not an AI-to-human handoff. Missing for 10: documented message-taking by the AI agent, documented escalation or handoff to a human agent, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: AI Agents handle after-hours calls, manage peak volume, and respond to repetitive requests automatically.
